title: Paths a template renders from input data are held to the portable-path predicate code point by code point, name by name, at its length boundaries at the defaults and among themselves, and the render is refused before anything is written
notes: ADR-005's path cases. Each data file holds both sides of its boundaries, and an accepted name gives no finding: in characters, one code point of each general category L, M, N, P and S and U+0020; in reserved-names, every Windows device name bare, with one and two extensions and with spaces before its extension, every .git spelling, and near misses of both; in lengths, segments of 255 and 256 bytes, paths of 512 and 513 bytes and of 32 and 33 segments, at the default limits, the 513-byte path in a declaration of its own because a path rendered past path-length ends its declaration's render; in collisions, NFC beside NFD, full case folding (U+FB00 beside ff) and a file beside a directory of its name.
